description: Searches published destination wedding venues by country, venue type, guest capacity and price range. Results include descriptions, photos and listing links, with totals and pagination; summary omits descriptions and images. Unknown capacity and unverified imported price bands are null. This search does not check live availability or make bookings.

capacity_max.description: Upper end of your guest range. Matches venues with a known capacityMin no larger than this; unknown capacity is excluded.

capacity_min.description: Lower end of your guest range. Matches venues with a known capacityMax at least this large; unknown capacity is excluded.

offset.description: Number of results to skip; nextOffset from the previous page continues the result set.

summary.description: Return compact comparison fields without descriptions and images (default false).

name: search_venues
title: Search Wedding Venues
